What if the best app to buy is the one that already had its viral moment and crashed? Patrick and Pablo run Social, a $16 million a year app studio that stayed profitable while raising just $1 million and once hit $11 million in revenue with only 11 people, a full $1 million per employee. In this episode I sit down with them to pull back the curtain on how they buy declining apps cheap and turn them into their biggest winners, run 4,000 fully AI video ads every month, and build a testing machine designed to eventually hand the company over to AI agents.

You will see the exact data playbook they use to spot underpriced apps, from a top down read on market size and willingness to pay to a bottom up test where they run standardized ads for apps they do not even own yet. Patrick and Pablo expose the onboarding paywall test that broke the number one rule in their industry, why removing the paywall on Celebs actually made more money by shifting conversion deeper into the funnel, and how they tripled revenue per user across the portfolio in 18 months. They explain their system of tagging the reasoning behind every AB test so an AI agent can learn why each decision was made, how they run 4,000 AI ads a month while growing their creative team instead of cutting it, and the infinite search space idea that governs how they explore new ad angles.
